edges.reason: msg.sender becomes owner, fee exempt, King and receivers in the constructor.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the transfer sender.
transfer delegates to _transferFrom.
transferFrom delegates to _transferFrom after allowance accounting.
msg.sender is the spender in transferFrom and its allowance is read.
_allowances[sender][msg.sender] is decremented in transferFrom.
_transferFrom calls _checkTxLimit before mutating balances.
_transferFrom conditionally triggers swapBack before the transfer.
_transferFrom calls takeFee for non-exempt transfers.
_transferFrom returns _basicTransfer while inSwapAndLiquify is true.
_transferFrom requires !isWalletToWallet(sender, recipient).
inSwapAndLiquify selects the _basicTransfer path and skips fees/limits.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to marketingWallet.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to the user-controlled King.
swapBack invokes the router swap for tokens.
swapBack invokes addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
marketingWallet receives ETH via call and could re-enter the transfer path.
The user-controlled King address receives ETH via call and could re-enter.
The router token swap moves tokens and can invoke token callbacks during swapBack.
The state variable King is the target of the ETH low-level call.
marketingWallet is the target of the ETH low-level call.
_checkTxLimit promotes the recipient to King on a new biggest buy.
_checkTxLimit updates biggestBuy from router-derived ETH value.
_checkTxLimit updates lastKingChange with block.timestamp.
_checkTxLimit calls _reset when the period expired or the King sold.
_checkTxLimit marks hasSold[sender] when the King sells.
block.timestamp - lastKingChange governs the King reset in _checkTxLimit.
_reset stores block.timestamp as the new lastKingChange.
swapBack passes block.timestamp as swap and liquidity deadlines.
_reset sets King back to marketingWallet.
_reset clears biggestBuy to zero.
_reset overwrites lastKingChange.
totalFee is used as a divisor in swapBack; a zero value causes division by zero.
takeFee applies totalFee as the buy fee percentage.
takeFee applies totalFeeIfSelling when the pair is the recipient.
setFees overwrites liquidityFee.
setFees overwrites marketingFee.
setFees overwrites kingFee.
setFees changes the fee components but never recomputes totalFee, which is still used as a divisor.
takeFee credits the accumulated fee to _balances[address(this)].
feedTheBeast moves a bot balance into _balances[address(this)].
recoverLosteth is guarded by the authorized modifier reading msg.sender.
recoverLostTokens is guarded by the authorized modifier reading msg.sender.
authorizations mapping is checked before ETH recovery.
owner authorization is checked before ETH recovery.
recoverLosteth forwards the full contract balance via transfer.
recoverLostTokens calls an arbitrary external token's transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the recovered ETH.
The caller-supplied token address becomes the external call target.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and mutates owner using the supplied address.
authorize is onlyOwner and grants authorizations.
Constructor sets King to the deployer.
Constructor instantiates the router.
Constructor creates the liquidity pair via the factory.
Constructor computes totalFee by adding the three fee components without a zero check.
Constructor mints _totalSupply to the deployer balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only feeds the internal transfer path and its wallet limits.
The amount parameter is consumed by the internal transfer and fee logic.
The sender parameter only exists to serve _transferFrom and _checkTxLimit.
The spender parameter is used exclusively for allowance accounting in transferFrom.
The arbitrary token address is only used as the external call target in recoverLostTokens.
The token amount parameter is only passed to the external IERC20 transfer.
The bot address is only read and zeroed inside feedTheBeast.
The new marketing wallet parameter is directly assigned to the marketingWallet state variable.
feeAmount is the intermediate fee result computed and credited inside takeFee.
amountReceived is the net credited value computed on the transfer path.
amountETH is the contract ETH balance read during the payout computation.
amountETHKing is only computed to be forwarded in the King ETH call.
tokensToLiquify is a transient value derived from swapThreshold inside swapBack.
amountToLiquify is the token amount passed into addLiquidityETH.
amountToSwap is the exact input forwarded to the router swap call.
usedEth is the router-derived ETH value that decides King candidacy in _checkTxLimit.
botBalance is read and zeroed inside feedTheBeast.
feeApplicable selects buy versus sell fee inside takeFee.
